title: Preserve governed calendar evidence in existing portfolio marks

root_causes: MarketMark.to_dict() omitted observed_at, lineage, and calendar_evidence when serializing mark_refs into pnl_snapshot and drawdown_snapshot metadata.

PaperRuntimeService._maybe_emit_performance_snapshots() returned early with performance_sample_unchanged when RollingDrawdownTracker.observe() saw an unchanged numeric sample fingerprint, preventing newly available governed provenance on the same sample from being emitted once through mark_refs.

RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore._rebuild_positions() and BFF _management_portfolio_holding_entry() used raw 48-hour (172800s) wall-clock age checks instead of delegating Taiwan symbols to the shared evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness rule, and RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore did not persist or enrich mark provenance on same-as_of snapshots.

remediation.summary: 1) MarketMark.to_dict() now serializes genuine observed_at, lineage, and calendar_evidence into mark_refs while keeping MarketMark equality/fingerprint unchanged. 2) RollingDrawdownTracker tracks last_mark_provenance across observe/export_state/restore and provides observe_unchanged_provenance(sample) so PaperRuntimeService._maybe_emit_performance_snapshots() emits pnl_snapshot and drawdown_snapshot once when an unchanged sample gains non-regressing mark provenance, then remains idempotent on subsequent polls and restarts. 3) Exported lightweight is_portfolio_mark_fresh in performance_telemetry.py, delegating Taiwan symbols to unchanged evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness and preserving flat [-300s, 172800s] bounds for non-Taiwan symbols. 4) RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore carries observed_at, lineage, and calendar_evidence into _marks_by_symbol and position rows, supports guarded same-as_of provenance enrichment (requiring identical binding_id, price, source_ref, compatible quote_currency, non-regressing provenance, and valid Taiwan calendar freshness), and evaluates position mark freshness via is_portfolio_mark_fresh. 5) BFF _management_portfolio_holding_entry resolves mark provenance from position, mark, or matching binding/as_of _marks_by_symbol and evaluates freshness via is_portfolio_mark_fresh.
invariants_preserved: True quote as_of (2026-10-22T00:00:00Z), source_ref, and max_mark_age_seconds (172800s) preserved; heartbeat/collected_at/observed_at never relabeled as quote as_of
Failed valuation precedence (_valuation_failure / mark_unavailable_reason) preserved over last-known provenance
Missing, malformed, future, untrusted/tampered calendar, or missed trading session (e.g. after 2026-10-27 13:30 Asia/Taipei close) remain stale/unavailable
Exact tenant, binding_id, runtime_id, and symbol isolation preserved; same-as_of provenance enrichment rejects different price, different source_ref, older observed_at, or regressed provenance
Unchanged-sample provenance emission fires once when governed provenance first appears and remains idempotent on subsequent polls and restarts
